dct_description_sm: Oceanographic data provide important information on the habitat features that support forage species and the marine predators they attract. The aim of this study is to collect fine-scale information on physical properties of the water column at biological hotspots on the Newfoundland shelf to characterize the habitat features of persistent marine sites that attract high densities of forage species and the marine predators that rely on them. These biological hotspots are ecologically important areas because energy flow through marine food webs, a key ecosystem process, is maximized in these areas.
dct_title_s: Oceanographic Properties of Newfoundland Labrador Shelf 2008
